title: Derived scalar extension isomorphism for supplied consecutive constant quotient models
statement: Under the same hypotheses as lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-model-reduction, the canonical derived scalar extension along the consecutive completion quotient map sends E′ to an object isomorphic to E.

source.place: Tag 09C6, consecutive quotient balancing; Tags 0D6D and 03Q3

proof.text: Apply the tower normalization after inverse image to the pointed etale chart, use tensor-pullback compatibility and the two supplied constant model isomorphisms, then commute the completion quotient maps. Constant realization scalar comparison identifies the resulting reduction with derived scalar extension. Exact geometric stalk comparison at the chosen point identifies this algebraic derived extension with E.

lean.statement:
theorem constantAdicQuotient_model_extension_iso
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : AdicTower X d) (n : ℕ) (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1 + 1))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (e' : Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d (n + 1)).obj E' ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op (n + 1)))).obj (M.level (n + 1))))
    (e : Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))) :
    Nonempty ((CategoryTheory.ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension
      (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := d.ideal.map
          (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
          (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).obj E' ≅ E)
